text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"That day, Lucky Lilac was looking over
the fan letters sent to her."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Lara-chan is so cute, I love her! I'm gonna go watch her race with my mom again!"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, gettin' such pure support like that
makes me feel like I really gotta do my best.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "I couldn't help but chuckle during your interview the other day. Not only are you gorgeous, but you're funny too—it's amazing!"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Whoops, better keep the goofin' around in check. Wouldn't do for the 'star attraction' to lose her poise.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Hm, this is...—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Huh, ah... Excuse me, did you call for me?
choice_data_list: Because you got quiet all of a sudden...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Well, um... this letter is
just so incredible, ya see..."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, Trainer?
There's something I'd like ya to watch with me."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What she showed me was footage of the Kikuka-sho,
where Orfevre had once achieved
the Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"She is strong, truly strong—Orfevre!
With a magnificent run, she clinches
the Classic Triple Crown!"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's truly breathtaking...
Don't you think so too, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: At this moment, every single person here is looking at Orfe-san, you know?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaah--!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Every time I saw Orfe-san win,
I always thought to myself..."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
So gorgeous, so overwhelming,
and sparkling so brightly—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Someone like that... is what you'd call a "star." I wished with all my heart that I could become one too—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case, could you take a look at this?
This letter...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The way La-san won was
so dazzling and overwhelming... Someday,
I want to become just like her—"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Do you think so too, Trainer?
Reading this brought back a whole flood of memories from before I came here.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: "Someday, I want to become a dignified, noble 'star' just like her."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: I was wonderin' if maybe... just maybe, I got a little bit closer to that dream.
choice_data_list: We need to get even closer from now on!
We should get even closer from now on, okay?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"...Come on! Would it kill ya to let me
bask in the moment just a wee bit longer?!"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
You're totally right.
I've gotta do it for her sake too, since she looks up to me so much.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"I shall bloom proudly
as a true star!"
